name: bronze
lore_descriptor: warm brown-gold, the metal of Troy and of every hero in Homer
first_pickup_chronicle: Took up bronze, older than iron. The first metal, not the strongest.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 0.80, weight_mult 1.05, effective_against fey (T1 specialty). Peak F5 spread 7 — common early. Slight weight penalty (1.05×). effective_against fey is a soft-mythological tie (bronze age vs the Tuatha).
